diagnosis.llm_reason: Rank 1 'Metastatic sarcoma with anemia and thrombocytopenia' names the same principal condition as the physician discharge diagnosis of high-grade unclassified sarcoma (malignant fibrous histiocytoma / undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma) with metastatic spread; the anemia and thrombocytopenia are bundled comorbidities in the same phrase and do not change the principal diagnosis. No other rank (anemia/thrombocytopenia, cervical degenerative change, renal failure, hypotension) names the sarcoma.
